text: 据每经，本周股指大幅回调，但资金蜂拥进场抄底，沪深两市股票型ETF和跨境型ETF合计净流入2113.21亿元。细分来看，主要宽基指数整体资金申赎统计显示，本周沪深300净流入400亿元。 在行业主题ETF方面，本周净流入资金超1亿元的基金有78只，其中科创芯片ETF嘉实、通信ETF国泰、半导体设备ETF易方达份额分别增加了10.65亿份、49.94亿份和18.18亿份，净流入资金42.04亿元、32.76亿元和23.35亿元。有券商表示，随着AIGC等人工智能技术发展，算力需求持续爆发，推动通信网络向高速率、大带宽、低时延方向演进，光通信、高速连接器等细
text_en: According to National Business Daily, major indices corrected this week, but funds rushed in to buy the dip. Total net inflows into Shanghai and Shenzhen stock ETFs and cross-border ETFs reached 211.321 billion yuan. Sub-divided, statistics on overall subscriptions and redemptions of main broad-based indices showed a net inflow of 40 billion yuan into the CSI 300 this week. In industry thematic ETFs, 78 funds saw net inflows exceeding 100 million yuan this week. Among them, the shares of Harvest SSE STAR Chip ETF, Guotai Communication ETF, and Yinhua Semiconductor Equipment ETF increased by 1.065 billion, 4.994 billion, and 1.818 billion units respectively, with net fund inflows of 4.204 billion yuan, 3.276 billion yuan, and 2.335 billion yuan. A securities firm noted that with the development of AIGC and other AI technologies, computing power demand continues to surge, driving communication networks towards high speed, large bandwidth, and low latency, with optical communication and high-speed connectors as key areas...
